method: Manually read all twenty full roots, connected fixtures and actual production targets. Metadata serialization and hashes over explicit inspected spans only. Baseline/current root files have identical Git blobs and bytes; raw declarations checked against exact survival rows. No source scanner/parser or project execution.

classification_definitions.integration: Material assertions traverse genuine project API/network/OS or production file output/readback boundary.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicate, serialization, concurrency or synthetic assertions without a material actual boundary; incidental setup insufficient.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent local-only blocks coexist with material real boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source or mapping evidence cannot support one of the other categories; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE; runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No builds, tests, runtime receipts or execution reviewed.
HTTP evidence is the source-visible loopback httptest server -> actual project handler -> history/event source -> JSON response path. No direct-recorder-only credit.
History Append/Range, gzip Export/Import and synthetic snapshots remain local operations. No persistence, process restart, JetStream KV, live OCI/member collector or live NATS stream claim follows.
File logging assertions cross the real os.File sink and os.ReadFile readback. No journald ingestion, crash durability or production sink acceptance is inferred.
Filesystem device evidence is conditional on Linux, and reaches read-only unix.Statfs/unix.Stat; no volume provisioning, mount manipulation or cloud store is exercised.

All safety/negative/authentication/correctness obligations retained. No source/ledger mutation, deletion, retirement, runtime qualification or completion/count promotion. Distinct independent peer review required.
